patches.title: Countertop Ascending Order
patches.principle: Search countertop 1, then 2, then 3 in ascending order before any containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When the cleaning target is not yet found and countertops exist.

patches.title: Direct Post-Clean Placement
patches.principle: After cleaning, go directly to the destination and place the object without detours.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have just cleaned an object and know the target location.

patches.title: Exhaust Open Surfaces First
patches.principle: Do not open drawers or cabinets until all open surfaces have been inspected.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for a cleaning object and surfaces like countertops remain.
